sectiondef.header: Polling helpers with interrupt-based error check (WithEC)

description.para: Each helper issues a low-level BSP operation and polls its completion bit while checking the ISR error flags (timeout / arbitration loss).

briefdescription.para: Transmits a NACK and waits for completion.
Transmits an ACK and waits for completion.
Waits until the received ACK/NACK bit is valid.
Issues a (repeated) START and waits for completion.

detaileddescription.para: Resets the timeout/arbitration-loss flags before polling.

briefdescription.para: Issues a STOP and waits for completion.

detaileddescription.para: Resets the timeout/arbitration-loss flags before polling.

briefdescription.para: Transmits one byte and waits for the target acknowledge.

detaileddescription.para: Static pool of controller instances (size from userDef.h).
Applies the timing configuration, connects the I2C ISR to the interrupt controller and enables the DROP (timeout) interrupt.

parameterdescription.para: Controller configuration; deviceId selects the instance.

memberdef.argsstring: (i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 regAddr, u8 *data, u32 length)
memberdef.name: i2c_writeRegMultipleBytes

briefdescription.para: Writes length bytes to a register, MSB first.

parameterdescription.para: Buffer with the bytes to write.

simplesect.para: I2C_WRAPPER_OK on success, negative i2c_wrapper_err_t code on error.

memberdef.argsstring: (i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 regAddr, u8 *data, u32 length)
memberdef.name: i2c_readRegMultipleBytes

briefdescription.para: Reads length bytes from a register, MSB first, using a repeated start.

parameterdescription.para: Receives the data bytes on success.

simplesect.para: I2C_WRAPPER_OK on success, negative i2c_wrapper_err_t code on error.

briefdescription.para: Writes a single byte to an 8-bit register (1-byte special case of i2c_writeRegMultipleBytes()).

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the byte to write.

simplesect.para: I2C_WRAPPER_OK on success, negative i2c_wrapper_err_t code on error.

briefdescription.para: Reads a single byte from an 8-bit register (1-byte special case of i2c_readRegMultipleBytes()).

parameterdescription.para: Receives the register byte on success.

simplesect.para: I2C_WRAPPER_OK on success, negative i2c_wrapper_err_t code on error.

briefdescription.para: Writes length bytes without a register pointer (raw write).

parameterdescription.para: Buffer with the bytes to write.

simplesect.para: I2C_WRAPPER_OK on success, negative i2c_wrapper_err_t code on error.

briefdescription.para: Reads length bytes without a register pointer (raw read).

parameterdescription.para: Receives the data bytes on success.

simplesect.para: I2C_WRAPPER_OK on success, negative i2c_wrapper_err_t code on error.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the timeout / arbitration-loss error flags evaluated by the polling helpers and clears all interrupt flags.

briefdescription.para: Implementation of the I2C master wrapper.

detaileddescription.para: Transfers are polled; the ISR only sets error flags (timeout, arbitration loss) which the polling loops check, so a stuck bus aborts the transfer instead of hanging forever.
